title: Written before me, signed before me
discussedAt: Not discussed in Derech Tevunos; labelled from stock phrases for the nested-rail study
about: Gittin 2a–3a — `בפני נכתב ובפני נחתם`: Rabbah and Rava.

A two-sided dispute of the fixture's shape, in miniature: every long-reaching move lands on Rabbah or on Rava, and the two sides' threads alternate. Opening Rava's thread while a later move on Rabbah is the attention puts Rava's rail inside Rabbah's.
hint: Where to look: at **25** a question on Rabbah arrives over both sides’ finished threads. Click the band under Rava (*under Rava: because witnesses…*) and Rava’s rail opens inside Rabbah’s.

units.speaker: Mishnah
units.short: Mishnah: one who brings a bill of divorce from…
units.he: המביא גט ממדינת הים צריך שיאמר בפני נכתב ובפני נחתם
units.en: Mishnah: one who brings a bill of divorce from abroad must declare it was written and signed before him

units.short: Why?
units.he: מאי טעמא?
units.en: Why?

units.speaker: Rabbah
units.short: Rabbah: because abroad they are not versed in…
units.he: רבה אמר: לפי שאין בקיאין לשמה
units.en: Rabbah: because abroad they are not versed in writing it for her sake

units.speaker: Rava
units.short: Rava: because witnesses are not available to…
units.he: רבא אמר: לפי שאין עדים מצויין לקיימו
units.en: Rava: because witnesses are not available to ratify it

units.short: What is the practical difference?
units.he: מאי בינייהו?
units.en: What is the practical difference?

units.short: Two bearers; province to province in the Land;…
units.he: איכא בינייהו דאתיוהו בי תרי
units.en: Two bearers; province to province in the Land; within one province abroad

units.short: For Rabbah, require two witnesses, as for all…
units.he: ולרבה דאמר לפי שאין בקיאין לשמה — ליבעי תרי!
units.en: For Rabbah, require two witnesses, as for all testimony

units.short: One witness is believed in matters of…
units.he: עד אחד נאמן באיסורין
units.en: One witness is believed in matters of prohibition

units.short: Only where no prohibition is established; here…
units.he: אימור דאמרינן עד אחד נאמן באיסורין… אבל הכא דאיתחזק איסורא
units.en: Only where no prohibition is established; here she is an established married woman, a matter of two

units.short: Most are versed; the requirement is rabbinic,…
units.he: רוב בקיאין הן… והכא משום עיגונא אקילו בה רבנן
units.en: Most are versed; the requirement is rabbinic, and they were lenient lest she be stranded

units.short: Lenient? It is strict: with one witness the…
units.he: האי קולא הוא?! חומרא הוא!
units.en: Lenient? It is strict: with one witness the husband can protest and invalidate it

units.short: Since it is given before two or three, he…
units.he: כיון דאמר מר: בפני כמה נותנו לה?
units.en: Since it is given before two or three, he checks first and will not undo himself

units.short: For Rava, require two witnesses, as for…
units.he: ולרבא דאמר לפי שאין עדים מצויין לקיימו — ליבעי תרי!
units.en: For Rava, require two witnesses, as for ratifying any document

units.short: One witness is believed in matters of…
units.he: עד אחד נאמן באיסורין
units.en: One witness is believed in matters of prohibition

units.short: Only where no prohibition is established; here…
units.he: אימר דאמרינן עד אחד נאמן באיסורין… אבל הכא איתחזק איסורא
units.en: Only where no prohibition is established; here it is

units.short: Ratification itself needs none by right, as…
units.he: בדין הוא דבקיום שטרות נמי לא ליבעי
units.en: Ratification itself needs none by right, as Reish Lakish said; the rabbis required it and were lenient here

units.short: Lenient? It is strict
units.he: האי קולא הוא?! חומרא הוא!
units.en: Lenient? It is strict

units.short: Since it is given before two or three, he…
units.he: כיון דאמר מר: בפני כמה נותנו לה?
units.en: Since it is given before two or three, he checks first

units.short: Why does Rava not say as Rabbah?
units.he: ורבא, מאי טעמא לא אמר כרבה?
units.en: Why does Rava not say as Rabbah?

units.short: The mishnah does not say 'written for her sake'
units.he: אמר לך: מי קתני בפני נכתב לשמה?
units.en: The mishnah does not say 'written for her sake'

units.short: And Rabbah?
units.he: ורבה?
units.en: And Rabbah?

units.short: It should have; but a longer formula would be…
units.he: בדין הוא דליתני הכי, אלא דאי מפשת ליה דיבורא אתי למגזייה
units.en: It should have; but a longer formula would be clipped

units.short: Now too he may clip it
units.he: השתא נמי אתי למגזייה!
units.en: Now too he may clip it

units.short: One of three is clipped; one of two is not
units.he: חדא מתלת גאיז, חדא מתרתי לא גאיז
units.en: One of three is clipped; one of two is not

units.short: Why does Rabbah not say as Rava?
units.he: ורבה, מאי טעמא לא אמר כרבא?
units.en: Why does Rabbah not say as Rava?

units.short: Then 'signed before me' alone would do;…
units.he: אם כן ניתני בפני נחתם ותו לא; בפני נכתב למה לי?
units.en: Then 'signed before me' alone would do; 'written' shows the requirement is for her sake

units.short: And Rava?
units.he: ורבא?
units.en: And Rava?

units.short: It should have; but it would be confused with…
units.he: בדין הוא דליתני הכי, אלא דאם כן אתי לאיחלופי בקיום שטרות דעלמא
units.en: It should have; but it would be confused with ordinary ratification by one witness

units.short: Rabbah: is it alike? There 'we know', here…
units.he: ורבה: מי דמי?! התם ידעינן הכא בפני
units.en: Rabbah: is it alike? There 'we know', here 'before me'; there a woman is not believed, here she is

units.short: Rava: here too 'we know' would be believed, so…
units.he: ורבא אמר לך: אטו הכא כי אמרי ידעינן מי לא מהימני?!
units.en: Rava: here too 'we know' would be believed, so the confusion stands

units.short: For Rabbah, which tanna requires both writing…
units.he: ולרבה דאמר לפי שאין בקיאין לשמה, מאן האי תנא
units.en: For Rabbah, which tanna requires both writing and signing for her sake?
